    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.IsGenericBrick.exists_separating_real_weight (k : Type u) [Field k] {R : Type u} [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsArtinianRing R] {G : ModuleCat R} (hG : IsGenericBrick k G) (h : EqualClassHom (FGModuleCat R)) :
    ∃ (v : RealProjectiveSpace R), v ≠ 0 ∧ (∀ (Q : FGModuleCat R) (q : G ⟶ Q.obj), Function.Surjective ⇑(ModuleCat.Hom.hom q) → 0 ≤ (realEulerEvaluation k (GrothendieckGroup.of Q)) v) ∧ ∀ (N : FGModuleCat R) (i : N.obj ⟶ G), Function.Injective ⇑(ModuleCat.Hom.hom i) → (realEulerEvaluation k (GrothendieckGroup.of N)) v ≤ 0

    Over an algebra satisfying equal-class Hom, a hypothetical generic brick admits a nonzero real projective weight nonnegative on every finite quotient and nonpositive on every finite submodule.
